Appreciate the numbers — super helpful. Quick sizing guidance based on Redwood Dedicated benchmarks and typical LLM profiles. These are conservative, workload-dependent estimates; we'll refine after the sample prompts/benchmarks.

Short summary (your profile: 40 peak TPS, 25-30 concurrency, 80/20 short/long token mix):
- A100 (NVIDIA A100, 80GB equivalent): ~20-35 TPS per GPU for short prompt loads (<=64 tokens) depending on model size and quantization. For mixed workloads with ~20% long sessions (~1k tokens), effective peak TPS drops to ~8-12 TPS per GPU.
- H100 (NVIDIA H100): ~40-65 TPS per GPU for short prompt loads; for your mixed token mix expect ~15-25 TPS per GPU effective.

Recommendation:
- If latency and headroom are critical and budget allows: start with 2x H100 GPUs and validate. That setup should cover ~30-50 effective TPS for mixed workloads and hit lower latency p95 targets.
- If budget-conscious: 4x A100 is a reasonable starting point — gives similar aggregate capacity but with higher p95 latency on bursty traffic.
- For final sizing, we usually recommend running a quick Redwood-managed benchmark on 5-10 representative prompts. We can do this in a non-prod VPC within 48-72 hours of getting samples and an account contact.

Other notes:
- Onboarding lead time for Dedicated: 4-6 weeks from contract signature for standard Dedicated (provisioning, network setup, KMS). If you choose a Private on-prem package, timeline is longer (6-10 weeks) depending on site access and IT approvals.
- Billing: we'll provide a tailored quote; I've attached an updated capacity calc and starter pricing.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Emma to share 5-10 redacted prompts + representative response sizes.
2) We run a short benchmark and return concrete TPS/concurrency numbers per GPU with the actual model you plan to use.
3) Marissa will prepare a formal quote and onboarding timeline once sizing is validated.
